newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen 91-day treasury bills yield avg 13.13 pct.
newsitem.headline: Yemen 91-day treasury bills yield avg 13.13 pct.

text.p: Yemen's Central Bank on Tuesday said its latest issue of 91-day treasury bills yielded an average of 13.13 percent, down from 13.35 percent at the July 8 auction.
Of the 1.6 billion rials worth of treasury bills on offer, the issue attracted bids worth 1.46 billion rials.
The average price was 9,683.02 rials and the lowest accepted price was 9,630 rials. Yields ranged from 11.13 percent to 15.41 percent.
The latest issue of 182-day treasury bills yielded an average of 12.93 percent.
Of the 600 million rials worth of 182-day treasury bills on offer, the issue attracted 322.6 million rials.
The average price was 9,394.16 rials and the lowest accepted price was 9,261 rials. Yields ranged from 12.25 percent and 16 percent.
The latest issue of 364-day treasury bills yielded an average of 13.71 percent.
Of the 400 million rials worth of 364-day treasury bills, on offer, the issue attracted subscriptions worth 280 million rials
The average price was 8,797.23 rials and the lowest accepted price 8,752 rials. Yields ranged from 12.49 percent and 13.30 percent.
